thread:
maria.g: Hey team — my PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821|#4821> is blocked by CI. Failing on the macOS UI snapshot test in the renderer shard. Can someone take a quick look? :sadge:

sam.k: I can eyeball it in a bit. Which test is it?

maria.g: `RendererSnapshot.test/fallback-font-render` — failure only on mac-latest in shard-4. Linux and windows shards passed.

jen: :eyes: I pulled the buildkite job logs: `AssertionError: image diff > threshold (0.07 vs 0.02)` — looks like a tiny glyph rendering shift. Stack trace attached in the job.

kevin: This smells like the recent font-config change in #4799. Maria, did you rebase onto main after that landed?

maria.g: Yep rebased earlier today. I ran unit tests locally but not full snapshots.

sam.k: Quick plan: (1) reproduce locally on mac-12 (2) try targeted rerun for shard-4 on CI (3) if nondet, consider snapshot update with justification.

maria.g: Repro steps I used locally: `yarn test:ui RendererSnapshot.test -u` — I can try on my macbook and report back.

ci-bot: Buildkite: Re-run requested by sam.k - job 4821-shard-4 (replay).

jen: After rerun, job still failed but diff is smaller: `0.045`. That suggests flakiness rather than deterministic regression.

tia: If it's flaky we shouldn't update snapshots blindly. Can we add a tolerance or rebaseline only the specific glyph?

kevin: We added tighter antialiasing in #4799 which reduced tolerances in a couple of tests. For this PR, we could either (A) increase threshold for that specific test to 0.06 with a comment linking to the upstream change, or (B) pin the font config in the test harness.

maria.g: Option A seems easiest to unblock. I'm fine bumping the threshold and leaving a TODO to revisit if more failures crop up.

sam.k: Happy with A if we also add a CI annotation and mention in the changelog. Who can approve the change? Need 2 reviewers to merge; I'm +1.

jen: I'll give a review after you push the threshold tweak. Please include the failing diff image in the PR description for traceability.

maria.g: Pushed `test: bump renderer snapshot tolerance for mac` — upstream CI kicked off. PTAL @sam.k @jen

ci-bot: Buildkite: Job 4821-shard-4 started (targeted run).

jen: LGTM on the toleration change. Left one nit about the comment text.

sam.k: Approving now. @kevin can you give the second approval? We want to merge before tomorrow's deploy window.

kevin: Approved. Leave note to revert if we see >3 regressions in a week.

ci-bot: Buildkite: All shards passed. Merge queue slot assigned.

maria.g: Thanks all! I'll add the changelog note and a quick follow-up ticket to audit snapshot thresholds.

tia: Nice — thanks for coordinating. :merge:

sam.k: If anyone sees a burst of snapshot failures, add the label `ci:flake-investigate` and we can loop in QA.

maria.g: Will do. Closing the loop here — root cause likely AF change from #4799, tolerance bump unblocks merge for now.
